@@ -21,14 +21,19 @@
     to_depot = distance_matrix[depot][unvisited_nodes]
     d_cur_depot = distance_matrix[current_node][depot]
 
-    # Clarke-Wright insertion savings: benefit of linking current -> node -> depot
-    # instead of current -> depot plus a fresh depot -> node leg.
+    # Clarke-Wright style savings: linking current -> node -> depot.
     savings = d_cur_depot + to_depot - cur
 
     dem = demands[unvisited_nodes].astype(float)
     cap = max(float(rest_capacity), 1e-12)
-    fill_bonus = (dem / cap) * (d_cur_depot + 1e-9) * 0.5
 
-    scores = savings + fill_bonus
+    # Weighted capacity fill: prefer nodes using a large fraction of remaining
+    # capacity, but scale by the depot fallback distance so far nodes still
+    # contribute meaningfully to route extension.
+    fill_ratio = dem / cap
+    proximity = to_depot
+    fill_weight = 0.35 * (d_cur_depot + 1e-9) / (np.mean(proximity) + 1e-9)
+
+    scores = savings + fill_weight * fill_ratio * proximity
 
     return int(unvisited_nodes[int(np.argmax(scores))])

generation_parents.algorithm: Clarke-Wright savings selection augmented with a capacity-fill bonus scaled by the ratio of node demand to remaining capacity, blended by a tunable weight.

declared_hypothesis: A focused revision may improve measured distance.
